basis: Bacterial infection; direct skin/soft-tissue infection, typically bite-associated cellulitis, accounts for the majority (>50%) of human presentations.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: skin and soft-tissue infection is the predominant human presentation (>50%), with direct tissue inflammation.

basis: Skeletal disease, alopecia and malabsorption define syndrome; nephrogenic DI annotated 80-99%. Endocrine findings omitted at cap; autoimmunity remains suspected.

decisions.renal: involved: supplied HPO reports nephrogenic diabetes insipidus in 80-99%, supporting a common renal concentrating defect.
decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: intestinal malabsorption and diarrhea are defining syndrome features, reported in approximately 50-60%.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: the supplied definition describes autoimmunity as suspected; immunosuppressive treatment alone does not establish an immune mechanism.

basis: Hindbrain malformation and developmental delay define disease. Polydactyly occurs in 2/5 (40%) without demonstrated functional skeletal damage; other damaging organ findings are below 30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: polydactyly in 2/5 (40%) establishes an anatomical variant, but the record does not demonstrate skeletal functional impairment.

basis: Adult botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma predominantly arises in cervicovaginal mucosal soft tissue, outside the axes; skeletal-muscle differentiation does not establish skeletal-muscle origin.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: myogenic differentiation does not establish origin in skeletal muscle; predominant adult cervicovaginal sites have no axis.

basis: Nasal dermoid cysts arise in nasal skin/subcutis; the nose also belongs to the pulmonary axis. Intracranial extension is a minority finding.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: a nasal dermoid is a congenital cutaneous/subcutaneous cyst or sinus, making skin/subcutis a site of the lesion.

basis: Plantar fascial fibromatosis; persistent loss of skin elasticity is annotated 80-99%, with subcutaneous nodules in 30-79%. Peripheral neuropathy occurs in only 5-29%.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent skin tethering/loss of elasticity (80-99%) supports direct cutaneous impairment; subcutaneous nodules occur in 30-79%.

basis: Hepatic steatosis, inflammation and fibrosis define the disease. Associated diabetes, dyslipidemia and other cardiometabolic conditions are separately diagnosed disorders.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: metabolic dysfunction qualifies this hepatic disease; associated diabetes and lipid disorders do not establish a separate endocrine/metabolic axis.

basis: Named muscle/liver syndrome with obligate cerebellar abnormalities and muscular dystrophy; retinal dysplasia occurs in 100%. Orofacial clefting (80-99%) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.neurologic: primary: obligate cerebellar abnormalities, frequent major brain malformations and the intellectual-disability parent establish a defining neurologic component.

basis: Severe bone fragility, osteopenia and prenatal fractures define OI8. Developmental delay in 1/2 does not establish direct neurologic dysfunction independent of severe skeletal disability.

decisions.neurologic: none: developmental delay reported in 1/2 is insufficient to distinguish direct neurodevelopmental disease from limitations caused by severe skeletal disease.

basis: Intellectual disability and pigmentary mosaicism define syndrome; amblyopia/myopic astigmatism in 1/2 supports ocular dysfunction. Pes planus in 3/5 lacks demonstrated functional damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: pes planus in 3/5 (60%) and broad bones do not establish damaging skeletal disease or functional impairment.
